title: Top 80 Recent Machine Learning Interview Questions
scope: Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Scientist, Data Scientist, Research Engineer and AI/ML Engineer interviews
methodology: Questions are taken or closely paraphrased from publicly reported interview-question databases and candidate-report-based interview guides. Company tags are retained only where the source explicitly attributes the question to that company. Questions may have multiple company tags when independently reported across companies.

source_notes.OpenAI: PracHub reports 28 ML questions for OpenAI overall and 22 specifically for Machine Learning Engineer roles, with multiple 2026 questions including 1NN, cross-entropy, noisy labels, matrix gradients and Transformer debugging.
source_notes.Amazon: PracHub reports 81 ML questions for Amazon and 80 for Machine Learning Engineer roles, including several 2026 questions on embeddings, GRPO, Transformers, RAG and model evaluation.
source_notes.Meta: PracHub reports 56 ML questions for Meta and 101 questions for Meta Machine Learning Engineer roles, including recent self-attention, embeddings, ranking and recommendation questions.
source_notes.Google: PracHub reports 44 ML questions for Google, including recent 2026 questions on VAEs, reward hacking, importance sampling, KL divergence, perplexity and LLM lifecycle.
source_notes.Apple: PracHub reports 14 ML questions for Apple, including 2026 questions on masked attention, vision failures, DCN v1/v2, dataset size and Siri/GPT routing.
source_notes.Microsoft: PracHub reports 20 ML questions for Microsoft, including 2026 questions on model selection, SHAP, OCR/LLM datasets, evaluation and preference alignment.
source_notes.NVIDIA: PracHub reports 7 ML questions for NVIDIA, including questions on calibration, drift, Transformers, parallelism and PyTorch tensor behavior.
source_notes.Tesla: PracHub reports 5 ML questions for Tesla, including RL for autonomous driving, Transformer backward passes, convolution parameter counts and sequence modeling.
source_notes.Anthropic: The 2026 Anthropic guide reviewed publicly shared candidate experiences and lists recurring questions on RLHF/DPO, alignment evaluation, training instability, Constitutional AI, distributed training and hallucination debugging.
source_notes.Google DeepMind: Dedicated 2026 sources report DeepMind ML questions involving reinforcement learning, optimization, attention scaling, loss functions, Bayes/probabilistic modeling and gradient-flow reasoning.
